name: Firecrawl
one_liner: Firecrawl is a web data API for AI agents that searches, scrapes, crawls, maps, and interacts with web pages and returns clean markdown or structured JSON.

auth.note: Bearer API key header; keyless endpoints; OAuth for apps

access.note: Free plan with no card, plus paid tiers

api_surface.note: Search, Scrape, Interact, Parse, Monitor, Crawl, Map, Agent endpoints

mcp.note: Official hosted MCP server with OAuth, API key, or keyless access

verdict.note: Free tier with credits enables immediate building

one_liner.note: Firecrawl helps AI systems search, scrape, and interact with the web

notes: OAuth for apps lets users connect their own Firecrawl account to a third-party app. Some endpoints (/v2/scrape, /v2/search, /v2/parse) also work keyless with limits. Open source and self-hostable. A community MCP repo also exists.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: HubSpot is a CRM platform that unifies marketing, sales, service, content and data hubs with built-in AI agents, and exposes a broad REST developer API and MCP servers.

auth.note: OAuth for multi-account apps, static auth tokens for single account
OAuth and private app access tokens as Bearer

access.note: Apps and tokens created from developer account; no sales gating shown
Pricing page fetched but content empty; free tools indicated by title only

mcp.note: Official remote MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com
Remote and local Developer MCP servers

verdict.note: Documented REST API with self-serve auth

notes: Pricing page content was empty, so free signup is inferred from developer docs, not confirmed. Some endpoints depend on account tier. Remote MCP uses OAuth (MCP only). Static auth tokens (new platform), legacy private app tokens and developer API keys (hapikey) also exist. Webhooks exist.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: FanBasis (now Commas) is an all-in-one platform for selling online, with checkout, payments, BNPL financing, affiliates, and course and community delivery for creators and digital businesses.

auth.note: API docs sit behind a password login, so auth is not visible

access.note: APIs are listed under an Enterprise offering; no self-serve API credentials are described
Marketing page with demo-call and account-creation calls to action

api_surface.note: Marketing mention of APIs and SDKs; no endpoints are documented

mcp.note: MCP is labeled beta on the marketing page, with no server URL or MCP docs page

notes: Auth undocumented in fetched pages. API docs are password-gated. REST is inferred from the marketing mention of 'APIs and SDKs'. The product was rebranded from FanBasis to Commas. The MCP 'beta' mention has no URL, so it is recorded as none. Access tier is inferred.
